review_text: Good place to eat while waiting for someone at the airport. They have meals, sandwiches and coffee. It's near the parking lot so it's easy to spot. They have a non-airconditioned and airconditioned space.

Update Nov '25: Very good again, I think the best place to wait and have something to eat at the Davao Airport. Beef soup was hot and good, chillies very hot. Beef burger steak good, and also the fish finger are tasty. We will be back. Update Jan '24: not available, not available, not available... Zoom wooz comes down to "standard philippino quality". Still good for waiting time, but no reason to come here for dinner etc. Wow! A real restaurant you like to visit at the airport of Davao... What's coming next? The zOoz wooz is also good enough to visit even w/o a flight... But you need to pay the parking fee
